journeys.name: Shape and accept a development contract
journeys.outcome: Turn ambiguous or brownfield work into an accepted immutable SpecRevision with explicit intent, scope, scenarios, constraints, provenance and non-empty acceptance expectations.
failure_recovery: unresolved material ambiguity => Inconclusive/return to research or clarification
changed accepted behavior => new SpecRevision, never silent edit

journeys.name: Decompose accepted intent into executable work
journeys.outcome: Create dependency-aware WorkPackages and Assignments with bounded context, allowed/forbidden surfaces, criteria, dependencies, authority and evidence expectations.
failure_recovery: cycle/unresolved dependency => block executable status
missing/non-empty criteria => NotConfigured; no assignment acceptance

journeys.name: Execute with isolated replaceable workers
journeys.outcome: Run an Attempt in an isolated resource boundary and produce an exact Candidate without mutating durable assignment identity.
failure_recovery: worker death/timeout => Attempt retained and new Attempt may replace it
claim expiry => authority ends
instruction change => revised SpecRevision/Assignment as required

journeys.name: Independently grade a candidate
journeys.outcome: Produce criterion-level results and evidence receipt for the exact candidate without worker self-award.
failure_recovery: evaluator unavailable => Unknown/Inconclusive
candidate mismatch/stale receipt => non-accepted
zero criteria => NotConfigured

journeys.name: Authorize accepted work
journeys.outcome: Award AcceptedWork only when mandatory correctness criteria pass and transition governance/authority also permits acceptance.
failure_recovery: correctness pass + policy deny => blocked
policy pass + correctness fail => unsatisfied
review/CI alone => insufficient

journeys.name: Promote or ship accepted work
journeys.outcome: Integrate/release/handoff the exact accepted candidate while failing closed on conflicts, stale acceptance or transport errors.
failure_recovery: merge conflict/error => no promotion
candidate changes => re-evaluation required
diagnostic bypass cannot authorize promotion

journeys.name: Resume after interruption without losing truth
journeys.outcome: Recover accepted spec, DAG, assignments, attempts, claims, candidates, evaluations and decisions sufficiently to continue without replaying owner context.
activities: resume with new Attempt or revised Assignment
failure_recovery: ambiguous authority/history => Inconclusive and require explicit reconciliation
expired claim never treated as active

journeys.name: Adapt methodology depth without weakening acceptance
journeys.outcome: Use a lightweight or deep workflow profile while preserving semantic prerequisites for accepted work.
failure_recovery: profile omits required criterion/authority/dependency => cannot reach AcceptedWork

journeys.name: Import or harmonize external specification frameworks
journeys.outcome: Map external framework artifacts into canonical AgilePlus roles/identities with provenance and aliases without creating competing accepted intent.
failure_recovery: conflicting accepted intent => no silent merge
unmapped semantics => preserve source and mark unresolved

journeys.name: Federate work evidence to Tracera
journeys.outcome: Hand exact candidate/evaluation/evidence references to Tracera without asserting product satisfaction.
failure_recovery: Tracera unavailable => AgilePlus standalone work truth remains intact
Tracera rejects applicability => AgilePlus accepted work remains accepted but product satisfaction remains non-green

journeys.name: Inspect the same work semantics across interfaces
journeys.outcome: CLI/API/MCP/human surfaces expose matching canonical identities, revisions, statuses and acceptance meaning.
activities: query same development/assignment/evaluation through supported surfaces
failure_recovery: transport disagreement => parity defect; no surface may manufacture a greener state

journeys.name: Audit who changed what and why
journeys.outcome: Trace accepted revisions, attempts, evaluations, authority and promotion history while correctly representing the audit-hash version/integrity envelope.
failure_recovery: v1 non-covered-field mutation => documented limitation, not false tamper claim
hash failure => explicit integrity failure
